audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer gave LeBlanc all seven rows; the content layer and the packet both hand Azir levels 6, first item and two items. Rows 4, 5 and 6 also had whys describing Azir winning the stage while the side beside them said LeBlanc.
audit.why: Distortion is 15s at rank 1 for 60-100 mana; Sigil is 6s. Her whole pattern is one burst rotation on a long dash. Once Emperor's Divide is up and Nashor's lands, a rotation she misses leaves her with nothing, which is why the content layer flips at 6.
audit.corrected: phases[4..6].side moved to Azir with all three whys rewritten in the same proposal. win[4..6] already read Azir, so the layers now agree. Levels 1-5 stay LeBlanc on both layers — that part was already right.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never attached a number to her spike and described Mimic as 'resetting' Distortion.
audit.why: Mimic is 45/35/25s and casts a mimicked version of one of her basic spells — she gets a second cast of Q, W or E, which is not the same as a reset. Her real lane spike is Distortion coming online at level 2 on a 15-second cooldown, falling to 10s at rank 5.
audit.corrected: Cooldown numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, the Do's bullet, tradeGood and tradeBad; the mid paragraph now describes Mimic as a second cast of a basic spell.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was missing: Ethereal Chains is a shackle that only becomes a root if it survives 1.5 seconds, and Azir's Shifting Sands is the tool that breaks it. breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Chains is 925 range on 14/13.25/12.5/11.75/11s and Riot's text is explicit that the root and the second damage instance only land if the target remains shackled for 1.5 seconds. Shifting Sands dashes 1100 units on 16-22s. Her Mirror Image passive triggers below 40% health, so a clone appears exactly when you think you have the kill.
audit.corrected: Stated in tldr, dontsFull[2].d and breakdown.cooldowns; the passive threshold noted rather than left as a surprise.

audit.whatIsWrong: Twenty-two lint findings — MISGENDER across tldr, winCon, tradeGood, loading, two phase whys, wave, trading, three Do's, a Don't and five report entries, plus two COPY_PASTE_BLEED bullets and the empty cooldowns field.
audit.why: LeBlanc is female per champ-data/champ-gender.js. dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim under a shove-and-ping title; dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim under a roam-pinging title.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed in every field edited here; both bled bullets replaced with bodies that answer their own titles.

notes: Chart resolved by moving the full layer's last three rows onto the content layer and the packet (Azir from level 6), with all three whys rewritten alongside the sides; win[4..6] already read Azir so no content chart edit was needed. I did not repeat the page's claim that Emperor's Divide can cut off Distortion's return — the return sends her back to her starting location and neither kit file says whether terrain interrupts it, so the text now only claims the knockback on her inbound dash, which the R description does support. Lint flagged MISGENDER on report[3].t, report[4].t, report[9].t and report[11].t as well; the two-rewrite cap on report[] meant those are untouched and still need a pronoun-only pass. Unverified: whether the Distortion return is blocked by terrain, and whether soldiers can body-block Sigil of Malice (Riot's text gives it no projectile flag).
